title: Iran’s Army Ground Forces Commander Brigadier General Jahanshahi: Wherever Iran’s interests require it, we will be present with full force.
text:
Iran’s Army Ground Forces Commander Brigadier General Jahanshahi: Wherever Iran’s interests require it, we will be present with full force."

"🔹 Brigadier General Jahanshahi said during a visit to the combat capabilities of Army Ground Forces units operating in western Iran that the units are on alert to confront any potential threats in border areas."

"🔹 The Army Ground Forces are stationed along the country’s borders and will be present with full force wherever Iran’s security and interests require their presence and defense.
